description_en: Moves an Express Connect Router (ECR) to a specified resource group
description_zh: 修改专线网关所属的资源组
kebab_example: aliyun expressconnectrouter move-resource-group --new-resource-group-id rg-acfmvt3xpr50000 --resource-type EXPRESSCONNECTROUTER --resource-id ecr-897j0jooxyr1aq0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: MoveResourceGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the new resource group. See https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94475.html
parameters.help_zh:
新资源组ID。
关于资源组的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94475.html
parameters.name: new_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The resource type. Valid value:

EXPRESSCONNECTROUTER: Express Connect Router
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型。可能的值：

EXPRESSCONNECTROUTER：专线网关
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance whose resource group you want to change
parameters.help_zh: 需要修改资源组的云资源的实例ID
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: Sends a check request without changing the resource group. The system checks whether the required parameters are specified, the request format is valid, and the service limits are met. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check passes, the `DryRunOperation` is returned.
false (default): Sends a normal request. If the request passes the check, a 2xx HTTP status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会修改资源组。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a token that is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

Code.description_en: The HTTP status code. A value of 200 indicates that the call was successful. Other values indicate that the call failed. For more information, see the error codes
Code.description_zh: 判断调用是否成功。返回值为200表示加载成功，返回其他值表示加载失败，失败原因参见错误码

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:

true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。取值：

true：成功。
false：失败
